launch_slurm_job: submit a FairChem job to a SLURM cluster using submitit AutoExecutor with configurable nodes and GPUs
launch_local_job: launch a FairChem job locally using torch elastic launch for multi-worker or single-process execution
create_slurm_spmd_program: create a SlurmSPMDProgram checkpointable entrypoint class for SPMD jobs launched via submitit on SLURM
map_job_config_to_dist_config: map a FairChem JobConfig to a distributed training config dict with world size and backend settings
remove_runner_state_from_submission: remove the runner state path from a submitit job submission pickle to prevent stale state resubmission on node failure
